about: Welcome to my corner of the web! I'm a Full Stack Software Engineer driven by a deep curiosity and a passion for crafting powerful, elegant, and scalable applications using JavaScript/TypeScript and its ecosystem.

highlights: Playing a pivotal role in a team responsible for creating a versatile cross-platform application, ensuring compatibility and optimal performance across mobile devices, web platforms, and hyperscale TV devices.
Developed comprehensive automated test scripts for internal modules using GitHub Actions to streamline development process.
Enhanced application performance significantly by implementing React Suspense and Lazy loading techniques, effectively reducing main thread load in browsers and optimizing user experience.
Lead the development of a cutting-edge 3D NFT marketplace platform from scratch using Next.js.
Implemented ThreeJS to provide users with an immersive experience, allowing them to render and upload 3D models for trading within the marketplace.
Automated the deployment process by creating a front-end build script that triggers deployment with every commit to the source control system.
Optimized our company site with lighthouse testing and achieved growth in app downloads by 80%
Developed a separate recruiting platform which helps to increase hiring ratio by 100%
Created a production-ready chat application in React Native for ~10,000 daily active users.
